question: The sum of two numbers is 78 and their L.C.M. is 180. What are the two numbers?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The fastest way to solve this is by verifying the given options.

Condition 1: Sum of the numbers = 78. (All given options sum up to 78)

Condition 2: L.C.M. of the numbers = 180.

Option 1: L.C.M. of 58 and 20 is 580. (Incorrect)

Option 3: L.C.M. of 60 and 18 is 180. (Matches perfectly)

**∴ The correct answer is 60, 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two numbers = 78

L.C.M. of the two numbers = 180

**Formula Used:**

Numbers = Hx and Hy (where H is the H.C.F., and x, y are co-prime integers)

Sum = H(x + y)

L.C.M. = Hxy

**Calculations:**

⇒ The H.C.F. of two numbers perfectly divides both their sum and their L.C.M.

⇒ H.C.F. of the numbers = H.C.F. of (78, 180) = 6

⇒ Let the two numbers be 6x and 6y, where x and y are co-prime.

⇒ Sum = 6x + 6y = 78

⇒ 6(x + y) = 78 ⇒ x + y = 13

⇒ L.C.M. = 6xy = 180

⇒ xy = 30

⇒ We need two co-prime numbers that add to 13 and multiply to 30.

⇒ The numbers x and y are 10 and 3.

⇒ The original numbers are 6 × 10 = 60 and 6 × 3 = 18.

**∴ The correct answer is 60, 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product of Numbers Rule

For any two numbers, the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their H.C.F. and L.C.M. (i.e., a × b = H.C.F. × L.C.M.).

Co-prime Factors

If two numbers have an H.C.F. of H, they can be represented as Hx and Hy, where x and y are always co-prime to each other.

Relation between Sum, L.C.M., and H.C.F.

The highest common factor (H.C.F.) of two numbers is mathematically equal to the H.C.F. of their Sum and their L.C.M.
